craft_notes: Sthāyin: praṇava-pouring. Sanskrit: praṇavādisamuccārāt plutānte...śūnyatām eti bhairavī → L4 keeps oṃ-etc + void-end + going-to-voidness. Rows: row 3 (by-void→goes). Close: Bhairavī (she goes — feminine agent at line end). Rejected: 'a-u-m' spelled — killed: oṃ etc kept (text's etc = pratāra etc.); 'annihilation' — killed: voidness kept (śūnya-tā as destination).

lines: Prolonged oṃ-uttering, at its end, void contemplated:
by void, by supreme power — to voidness goes, Bhairavī.
l4.sanskrit_cite: praṇavādisamuccārāt plutānte śūnyabhāvānāt | śūnyayā parayā śaktyā śūnyatām eti bhairavi

reads_against.argmap: What happens at prolonged oṃ? → Prolonged utterance ends in contemplation of void — to voidness she goes.
c1_essence: Prolonged oṃ ends in void-contemplation: to voidness she goes.
reads_against.c1_rasa: śānta with vīra (stillness with piercing resolve)
